description: Provision a Google Cloud Compute ComputeFirewallPolicyAssociation via Config Connector. Fields mirror the compute.cnrm.cloud.google.com/v1beta1 ComputeFirewallPolicyAssociation spec.

attachmentTargetRef.description: Immutable. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description:
The target that the firewall policy is attached to.

Allowed values:
* The Google Cloud resource name of a `Folder` resource (format: `folders/{{name}}`).
* The Google Cloud resource name of a Google Cloud Organization (format: `organizations/{{name}}`).

kind.description: Kind of the referent. Allowed values: Folder

name.description: [WARNING] Organization not yet supported in Config Connector, use 'external' field to reference existing resources. Name of the referent. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/names/#names

namespace.description: Namespace of the referent. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/namespaces/

firewallPolicyRef.description: Immutable. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: A reference to an externally managed ComputeFirewallPolicy resource. Should be in the format "locations/global/firewallPolicies/{{firewallPolicyID}}".

name.description: The name of a ComputeFirewallPolicy resource.

namespace.description: The namespace of a ComputeFirewallPolicy resource.

projectId.description: GCP project ID for this resource. Rendered as the cnrm.cloud.google.com/project-id annotation. Leave empty to inherit the project from the namespace (Config Connector falls back to the namespace's project-id annotation, then to the namespace name). Leave empty when this resource's spec already carries a projectRef.
projectId.title: GCP project ID

resourceID.description: Immutable. Optional. The name of the resource. Used for creation and acquisition. When unset, the value of `metadata.name` is used as the default.
